card: background-color: #fbf7ec; border: 1px solid #d8cfb8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 26px 22px; margin: 0 0 34px
p: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.9; color: #3a3226; margin: 0 0 20px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: text-align: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #2c6e63; letter-spacing: 6px; margin: 0 0 24px; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #3a3226; text-align: left; margin: 28px 0 14px; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
blockquote: background-color: #efe8d5; border-left: 3px solid #2c6e63; padding: 16px 20px; margin: 0 0 20px; color: #7c7365; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85; text-align: left
code: color: #4a4234; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #efe8d5; color: #2c6e63; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_item: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.9; color: #3a3226; margin: 0 0 10px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #e5dcc4; color: #3a3226; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #d8cfb8; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14px
footer_html: 掩卷
